name: @scion-slicer/mcp

tools.name: about
tools.description: Show the running Scion Slicer version, the latest version known on npm, whether an update is available, and how to update in this agent.

tools.name: check_print
tools.description: Check a resin print before slicing. Takes a binary STL in print orientation and reports resin traps (sealed pockets), suction cups (pockets open toward the vat film), peel alerts (sudden jumps in layer area, and the largest layer) and ledges (overhangs, with their depth in mm). Each finding has its layer range, location in mm, size, cause and a suggested action.

px_mm.description: Pixel size for the analysis, in mm. Default 0.05.

stl_path.description:
Absolute path to a binary STL, already in print orientation (lowest point is
what touches the build plate).

instructions: Scion Slicer: resin 3D printing tools built on the DragonFruit slicing engine. Use check_print on an STL in print orientation to find resin traps, suction cups, peel problems and ledges before slicing. If a tool result ends with a note that a newer Scion Slicer version is available, pass that note on to the user once.
